metadata.title: What is the identity of an Adivasi | आदिवासी पहचान क्या है?
metadata.description: India has a large population of Adivasis (about 10 percent of total indian population), despite this, many types of misconceptions and confusions are found in most of the people of the country about the tribal society. Now the tribals are becoming aware of their identity and rights. They want people of the world know the tribal culture in a better and positive way.
